title.zh: 萨满祭司练级加点指南

description.zh: 萨满祭司在 Beta 中的练级加点路线与逐点顺序。
description.en: Level-by-level Shaman talent orders in the Forever beta.

body.zh: 【元素 Beta 开荒】三个主力法术伤害提高 5%，火焰图腾与熔岩震击提高 15%，元素集中再提供免费施法。 【增强 Beta 开荒】全面 5% 暴击、把智力转成攻击强度，再用萨满专注止住震击的法力消耗。
body.en: [Elemental Beta Start] 5% more damage on your three main spells, 15% on fire totems and Flame Shock, and Elemental Focus for free casts. [Enhancement Beta Start] 5% critical strike with everything, Intellect turned into Attack Power, and Shamanistic Focus so shocks stop draining your Mana.

body.zh: 以上方案来自 Beta 版本 1.60.1.70425 的公开数据整理，正式版本上线后可能需要重新验证。
body.en: These builds come from published data for beta build 1.60.1.70425 and may need re-verification at launch.

provenance.source: wowhandbook.com recommended builds, beta client data
provenance.notes: Beta build 1.60.1.70425 recommendations; may change before launch.
